decisions.reason: The compact dumper with rotating skip extends the firm's established offer, was launched only in 2023 with its own web page, and any early weakness can still be attributed to start-up effects, so management stays committed.

The articulated construction dumper builds on core engineering competence and visible investment, fits the announced direction of refining the existing range, and has been on the market too short to judge, so it is kept.

Although the mine rescue vehicle is distant from the established offer and carries higher risk, the firm has made substantial specialized development investment and publicly committed to it, and slow sales in a long-cycle niche market are easily read as temporary, so it is kept.
The compact telescopic loader line with several models represents the largest visible investment and fits the firm's lifting core, so dropping it a year after launch is very unlikely.
